body: Should a class disabled in the build with this annotation be also excluded from the Jandex index or is it needed there for other purposes?
@geoandri maybe you can help ? When a `@IfBuildProfile` is present, will the class be removed from the Jandex index ?
Hi @phillip-kruger , I think that you meant to mention @geoand .

> @geoandri maybe you can help ? When a `@IfBuildProfile` is present, will the class be removed from the Jandex index ?

They will not be removed from the Jandex index. They are only removed from Arc
Thanks, that is the problem then. We look at jandex when we build the schema. So we will have to build in something specific for this case...

Let me know if you need anything from me
